mapper.select: SELECT consult_id FROM consultation WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND expert_id = #{expertId} AND consult_type = '채팅' AND status IN (1,2) ORDER BY consult_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consultation ( consult_type, expert_id, member_id, status, created_date ) VALUES ( #{consultType}, #{expertId}, #{memberId}, #{status}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT c.consult_id, c.member_id, u.nickname AS member_nickname, c.expert_id, exp.user_name AS expert_name, ( SELECT m.message_content FROM consult_chat_message m WHERE m.consult_id = c.consult_id ORDER BY m.created_date DESC, m.chat_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_time FROM consultation c JOIN user u ON c.member_id = u.member_id JOIN user exp ON c.expert_id = exp.member_id WHERE c.expert_id = #{expertId} AND c.consult_type = '채팅' AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.created_date DESC, c.consult_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation WHERE consult_id = #{consultId} AND (member_id = #{memberId} OR expert_id = #{memberId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation WHERE consult_id = #{consultId} AND (member_id = #{memberId} OR expert_id = #{memberId})
SELECT c.consult_id, c.member_id, c.expert_id, c.consult_type, c.status, c.consult_start_date, c.consult_end_date, c.created_date FROM consultation c WHERE c.consult_id = #{consultId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consult_chat_message ( consult_id, sender_id, message_type, message_content, created_date, is_read ) VALUES ( #{consultId}, #{senderId}, #{messageType}, #{messageContent}, NOW(), 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT m.chat_id, m.consult_id, m.sender_id, u.nickname AS sender_nickname, u.user_name AS sender_name, m.message_type, m.message_content, m.created_date, m.is_read FROM consult_chat_message m JOIN user u ON m.sender_id = u.member_id WHERE m.consult_id = #{consultId} ORDER BY m.created_date ASC, m.chat_id ASC

SELECT m.chat_id, m.consult_id, m.sender_id, u.nickname AS sender_nickname, u.user_name AS sender_name, m.message_type, m.message_content, m.created_date, m.is_read FROM consult_chat_message m JOIN user u ON m.sender_id = u.member_id WHERE m.consult_id = #{consultId} ORDER BY m.created_date ASC, m.chat_id ASC

SELECT c.consult_id, c.member_id, c.expert_id, u.nickname AS member_nickname, exp.user_name AS expert_name, c.status, ( SELECT m.message_content FROM consult_chat_message m WHERE m.consult_id = c.consult_id ORDER BY m.created_date DESC, m.chat_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message, ( SELECT m.created_date FROM consult_chat_message m WHERE m.consult_id = c.consult_id ORDER BY m.created_date DESC, m.chat_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message_time, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consult_chat_message m WHERE m.consult_id = c.consult_id AND m.sender_id != #{memberId} AND m.is_read = 0 ) AS unread_count FROM consultation c JOIN user u ON c.member_id = u.member_id JOIN user exp ON c.expert_id = exp.member_id WHERE c.consult_id = #{consultId}

SELECT c.consult_id, u.user_name, c.consult_type, COALESCE( ( SELECT m.message_content FROM consult_chat_message m WHERE m.consult_id = c.consult_id AND m.message_type = 'TALK' ORDER BY m.created_date ASC, m.chat_id ASC LIMIT 1 ), '요청 내용 없음' ) AS consult_content FROM consultation c JOIN user u ON c.member_id = u.member_id WHERE c.expert_id = #{expertId} AND c.consult_type = '채팅' AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.created_date DESC, c.consult_id DESC LIMIT 1
